preservedResponsibilities: Task4XSBZ5 implements the native document-bound ScViewData cursor subset, with actual borrowed ScDocument and ScMarkData. Per-sheet ScViewDataTable fields start at zero, old-cursor validity starts false, active pane starts SC_SPLIT_BOTTOMLEFT. SetTabNo keeps native ValidTab guard and lazily creates only the requested slot, independently of selected-sheet marks. Cursor accessors, old-cursor fallback/reset and absent-tab sentinel follow source. Coordinate setters retain caller validity preconditions rather than inventing clamping. JS GC replaces physical per-table ownership only; no cell data, document projection, allocator or window service is created. Header declarations are reexported from the TypeScript implementation as existing Calc boundaries do. Geometry,hidden/alternate sheet-view,zoom/window/configuration services are outside this cursor subset.

TaskGKVVR7 connects source standard automatic row-height arithmetic and genuine compressed geometry/flags to current FontHeight UI and attribute Undo/Redo. Original contiguous pool defaults extend through ATTR_MARGIN143. Standard uniform-script unwrapped/unrotated rows use native 256-twip startup minimum,23-twip correction,margin/emphasis and pixel-change conditions. Selected sheets retain one original shared context. React uses actual row segments and bounded physical scrolling; ODS row styles apply to real sheet storage. Device-based initialization/script scanning,rich/wrapped/rotated/merged layout,drawing/hidden rows and standalone height dialogs remain unported. Nonstandard represented attribute profiles decline adjustment;unrepresented foreign layout properties,mixed-script text and device layout remain unverified. Writer primary saving/no-recovery/visible-content policy is retained; broad parity remains unverified.

Task3ANMSS in-progress frame foundation ports native border defaults,actual ScItemPoolCache,attribute-run frame application/query,selected-sheet frames and line transformations. ScTabViewShell owns the native black20twip solid default line. ScViewFunc ApplyPatternLines and existing ScUndoSelectionAttr retain actual attribute documents,adjacent envelopes and source replay ordering,including CALC227 rectangular-redo envelope loss. Shared Writer border paint projection moves into SVX browser ownership without changing its CSS mapping. Focused frame/history and existing formatting tests provide bounded evidence;toolbar dispatch,presets,line-style/color workflows,ODS integration and whole-block verification are still pending. Native global undo enablement,protection,merged/rich-edit/drawing/device/alternate-view services and complete parity remain unverified. Existing browser primary saving/open/no-recovery behavior remains.
omittedResponsibilities: Only document-bound visible-sheet cursor/mark operations are ported; full ScViewData construction, geometry, scroll-position calculations, zoom, windows, hidden and alternate sheet views, persistence and view commands remain outside this slice.
No full native module contract/behavior/default parity or upstream native QA run is certified.
